# Attribution requirements (injected by run-claude-code composite)

You are running inside the GitHub Actions workflow
`{{WORKFLOW_REF}}` (event: `{{EVENT_NAME}}`). Every PR you open and
every issue you create MUST identify itself as coming from this
workflow. Three layers, all required.

## Required attribution layers

### 1. Title suffix

For PRs:

```text
<conventional-prefix>(<scope>): <description> [aw:{{SOURCE_SLUG}}]
```

For issues:

```text
[aw:{{SOURCE_SLUG}}] <description>
```

No emoji anywhere in PR/issue titles or bodies (project soul rule).
Conventional-commit prefix is preserved so release-please parses it.

### 2. Body Provenance block

Append this block exactly, at the very bottom of every PR body and
every issue body you create:

```markdown
---

## Provenance

- **Generated by:** [`{{SOURCE_SLUG}}` workflow]({{WORKFLOW_REF}}) - ai-workflows reusable workflow, event-driven
- **Triggered:** workflow run [`{{RUN_URL}}`]({{RUN_URL}}) on event `{{EVENT_NAME}}`
- **Why this PR/issue:** <one-line rationale tying the trigger event to this specific output>
- **Label:** `agentic-workflows`
```

Fill in the "Why" line with a sentence specific to this run. Leave
the rest of the values verbatim - they reference the variables
passed in via the composite action.

### 3. Label

After creating the PR or issue, apply the `agentic-workflows` label:

```bash
gh pr edit "$PR_NUMBER" --add-label agentic-workflows
gh issue edit "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --add-label agentic-workflows
```

The label is defined in `JacobPEvans/.github/.github/labels.yml`
and propagated to every public repo by the `label-sync.yml`
workflow - no need to `gh label create` per repo. If the
label-add call fails because the target repo lacks the label
(private repo outside sync), log the failure and continue.
